strategy_roster.name: Crossing of Two iMA v2
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(5), SMA(8), and SMA(13) approximate the documented smoothed moving averages and directional filter. The configured MA shifts, percentage sizing, pip stops, and trailing-stop state are not expressible in this single-series DSL.

strategy_roster.name: E-Skoch-Open Strategy (StockSharp Port)
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and roc(close,3) > 0 and close > ema(close,10)
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish three-bar momentum continuation with EMA(10) trend agreement is a fallback because the source does not specify its pattern thresholds. Martingale sizing, equity target, point offsets, and opposite-signal position state are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Zero-Lag MA Trend Following
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(34) is a documented-period proxy for the zero-lag MA, and the prior 14-bar high break approximates its ATR box breakout. ZLEMA arithmetic, the exact box, and dynamic ATR risk-reward exits are not available.

strategy_roster.name: SilverTrend V3 Strategy (C#)
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,20) > sma(close,50) and close > donchian_high_prev(high,20) and roc(close,10) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: EMA/SMA alignment, a prior 20-bar breakout, and positive momentum provide a trend-channel proxy for SilverTrend with J_TPO confirmation. Friday filtering, proprietary profile logic, price-step trailing, and point targets are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Day Trading Impulse
strategy_roster.notes: The documented MACD(12,26,9) crossover is retained, with RSI(5) and ROC(14) standing in for Stochastic and Momentum filters. Parabolic SAR, the 20-point target, 15-point trailing, and zero-point stop cannot be encoded as percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Donchian Channels System
strategy_roster.notes: The prior-bar Donchian boundaries directly represent the documented 20-period channel breakout and reversal. The configured two-bar Shift is not available beyond the built-in previous-bar helper, and the short side is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: ExFractals
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,15) and close-open > sma(close-open,15) and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 15-bar high break plus above-average body momentum and volume approximates averaged fractal levels and ExVol. Fractal confirmation, pip stop/target/trailing values, and pending-order mechanics are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: BTC Future Gamma-Weighted Momentum Model
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > sma(close * volume,60) / sma(volume,60) and roc(close,1) > 0 and roc(close,2) > 0
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < sma(close * volume,60) / sma(volume,60) or roc(close,2) < 0
strategy_roster.notes: A 60-bar volume-weighted price proxy replaces GWAP, while positive one- and two-bar ROC approximates three rising closes. The gamma weighting, exact sequential-close test, and opposite-signal short branch are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Sample Detect Economic Calendar
strategy_roster.notes: Calendar events are external inputs absent from the OHLCV DSL, so the impossible guard preserves the utility's lack of a deterministic market signal. Pending order placement, event timing, and point-based protection are not represented.

strategy_roster.name: Vwap Volume
strategy_roster.entry_long: close < sma(close * volume,20) / sma(volume,20) and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1.5
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar volume-weighted close substitutes for VWAP, and volume_ratio(20)>1.5 matches the documented participation threshold. The documented 2% stop is retained; the ATR stop wording and short side are not expressed.
